sources.title: Reproducing GPT-2 (124M) in llm.c in 90 minutes for $20 - GitHub
sources.snippet: The 124M model is the smallest model in the GPT-2 series released by OpenAI in 2019, and is actually quite accessible today, even for the GPU poor. With llm.c, which is quite efficient at up to ~60% model flops utilization, reproducing this model on one 8X A100 80GB SXM node takes ~90 minutes.
